title: Split-the-Bill: Complete Guide
summary: This guide covers Split-the-Bill rules and workflow: group size capped at 30 participants, total split amount capped at $5,500, payment due within 16 days from creation, and automatic reminders every 4. It explains creation/sending steps, tracking paid vs outstanding, and what to do when the due date passes (extend, resend, or resolve), plus edge cases like splitting into multiple groups when reaching 30.
faqs: What are the maximum limits for Split-the-Bill (participants and total amount)?
How do I create and send a Split-the-Bill request to participants?
When are payments due after the split is created (the 16-day window)?
How often do automatic reminders send (every 4), and can I nudge members manually?
How can I track which participants have paid vs who is outstanding?
If the due date passes, what actions does the guide recommend (extend, resend, resolve)?
keywords: extend / resend / resolve after due date
